### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report only objective findings (e.g., vital signs, physical exam results) explicitly stated or observed by the doctor in the transcript; do not infer or invent unmentioned measurements or observations.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately capture all patient-reported symptoms; do not omit or contradict any mentioned symptoms.
[P-Section]: When detailing current medications or supplements, explicitly list all items mentioned by the patient; do not state absence if any are reported.
